```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
imdb_urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)
imdb_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)

fetch_imdb_snapshot <- \(address, snapshot_year) {
  response <- request(address) |>
    req_timeout(120) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3, retry_on_failure = TRUE) |>
    req_perform()

  document <- resp_body_html(response)
  page_tables <- html_elements(document, "table")
  table_data <- map(page_tables, html_table)
  ranking_table_index <- which(
    map_lgl(
      table_data,
      \(table) all(c("Rank & Title", "IMDb Rating") %in% names(table))
    )
  )

  if (length(ranking_table_index) != 1) {
    stop("Expected one IMDb ranking table; found ", length(ranking_table_index))
  }

  ranking_table <- page_tables[[ranking_table_index]]
  ranking_data <- table_data[[ranking_table_index]] |>
    select(`Rank & Title`, `IMDb Rating`) |>
    mutate(`Rank & Title` = str_squish(`Rank & Title`)) |>
    separate_wider_regex(
      `Rank & Title`,
      patterns = c(
        rank = "\\d+",
        "\\. ",
        title = ".+",
        " \\(",
        year = "\\d{4}",
        "\\)"
      )
    )

  if (nrow(ranking_data) != 250L) {
    stop("Expected 250 IMDb rankings; found ", nrow(ranking_data))
  }

  vote_counts <- html_elements(ranking_table, "td.imdbRating strong") |>
    html_attr("title") |>
    str_extract("[0-9,]+(?= votes)") |>
    parse_number()

  if (nrow(ranking_data) != length(vote_counts)) {
    stop("The ranking rows and vote-count tooltips do not match")
  }

  tibble(
    snap_year = rep(as.integer(snapshot_year), nrow(ranking_data)),
    rank = as.integer(ranking_data$rank),
    title = ranking_data$title,
    year = as.integer(ranking_data$year),
    rating = parse_number(as.character(ranking_data$`IMDb Rating`)),
    number = vote_counts
  )
}

imdb_snapshots <- map2_dfr(imdb_urls, imdb_years, fetch_imdb_snapshot)
imdb_rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(snap_year, title, year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = snap_year, values_from = rank, names_prefix = "rank_") |>
  filter(!is.na(rank_2015), !is.na(rank_2022)) |>
  mutate(rank_change = rank_2015 - rank_2022) |>
  mutate(release_decade = floor(year / 10) * 10)

print(
  imdb_rank_changes |>
    arrange(desc(abs(rank_change))) |>
    slice_head(n = 10)
)

imdb_rank_changes |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(avg_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(release_decade)
imdb_snapshots |>
  count(title, name = "n_snapshots") |>
  count(n_snapshots, name = "n_films")
```

```{r}
imdb_rank_changes |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(avg_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      avg_rank_change > 0 ~ "Improved rank",
      avg_rank_change < 0 ~ "Declined rank",
      TRUE ~ "No average change"
    ),
    release_decade = factor(release_decade)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = avg_rank_change, y = release_decade, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray40") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Improved rank" = "#2878B5",
      "Declined rank" = "#D9534F",
      "No average change" = "gray60"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average IMDb Rank Change by Film Release Decade",
    subtitle = "Positive values indicate an improved rank from 2015 to 2022",
    x = "Average rank change (2015 rank minus 2022 rank)",
    y = "Release decade",
    fill = "Direction",
    caption = "Sample: 190 films appear in both the 2015 and 2022 snapshots."
  )
```
